description: This file implements a feature to list comments associated with an article identified by its slug. It includes a request object, a handler class to process the request asynchronously, retrieves data from the database, and handles errors if the article isn't found.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents the request to list comments for an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query to retrieve comments for an article. Uses Entity Framework to fetch data and throws a RestException if the article is not found.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the Query request asynchronously, querying the database for the article and returning its comments wrapped in a CommentsEnvelope.
